About us

Global presence, local impact.

From Buenos Aires, Comitia partners with governments and institutions across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, adapting its technology to each context, legal framework and real-world challenge.

Twelve offices let us support each process in its own time zone, language and regulatory framework.
